title: A Very Good Idea
content:
Tom works at a small company. One morning, he has a meeting with his manager.

— We have a very important meeting today — his manager says.

— What is the meeting about? — Tom asks.

— We have a really good idea for a new product.

Tom looks excited.

— That sounds very interesting!

They look at the plan together.

— The product is quite simple, but it can help many customers — the manager says.

— And the price is really good too — Tom replies.

After the meeting, Tom talks to his team.

— This is a very exciting project!

Everyone agrees.

At the end of the day, the manager smiles.

— You did a really good job today, Tom.

— Thank you! I think this business can be very successful.
